crossRefs.note: Now the Lord is the Spirit and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
But Yahweh said to Samuel, “Don’t look on his face, or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for I…
Will I eat the meat of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to…
The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.
If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.
For the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy, says: “I dwell in the high and holy place, with…
‘These people draw near to me with their mouth, and honor me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.
And in vain do they worship me, teaching as doctrine rules made by men.’ ”
For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience, that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom…

translations.web: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”
translations.bsb: God is Spirit, and His worshipers must worship Him in spirit and in truth.”
translations.kjv: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.
translations.asv: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship in spirit and truth.
